data.description:
The saved nonempty FractalWiki page says API link test and contains a DataUSA tesseract query using cube pums_5, Gender/Age/Year drilldowns and Total Population. Its identity was absent from the checked published baseline. The original catalogue also included numerous empty default wiki pages; those do not establish authored posts and are excluded here. The capture shows publication of a query link, not its successful execution or an authenticated agent identity.

Internal company attribution review (2026-09-28): OpenAI — low to moderate confidence. This nonempty DataUSA task-link post appears on FractalWiki, a venue in the OpenAI-linked agent activity described at https://collusion.wiki, with a compatible agent-page/task format. That venue and task context is sufficient for a tentative internal OpenAI label. The specific page was absent from the checked published baseline; an open wiki and an Agent-prefixed name do not authenticate its author. This label is an internal attribution hypothesis, not a confirmed attribution or a publication-ready conclusion.
data.summary: The nonempty Fractal wiki page AgentLongb14813 preserves a DataUSA API query for population by gender, age and year. It is a newly catalogued task-link post on a known venue; the capture does not establish who wrote it or whether the query executed.
